morning-brief/admin.name: Morning watchlist brief

nodes.label: Write brief
nodes.prompt: Use only figures that appear in the input data and name the date they are as of. Write a concise morning brief for an investor: the biggest movers, stocks near their 52-week high or low, notable technical signals (RSI, trend, crosses) and what to watch today. End with a short risk note. Markdown, under 300 words.

filings-monitor/admin.name: SEC filing monitor

nodes.label: Summarize
nodes.prompt: For each new SEC filing in the input, say what kind of filing it is and what an investor should check in it. Flag 8-Ks that may be material (results, guidance, leadership, deals, financing). Link every filing URL. Do not guess the contents of a filing you have not read.

filings-monitor/admin.note: Needs SEC_USER_AGENT on the server. Nothing runs past "New filings" when there is nothing new, so the agent costs nothing on quiet days.

quality-screen/admin.name: Quality & value screen

nodes.label: Memo bullets
nodes.prompt: Use only figures that appear in the input data and name the date they are as of. top10-buy-now/admin.name: Top 10 buy-now leaderboard

nodes.label: Pick memos
nodes.prompt: Use only figures that appear in the input data and name the date they are as of. Leaderboard scores are 0–100 percentiles within the ranked universe (value, quality, growth, momentum, timing, risk), not price targets or predictions. Keep the table at the top. Then for each company, in rank order, write two lines: why it ranks there (cite the strongest factor scores and their figures from reasons) and what to check before buying (flags, weakest factor, the next quarterly report). End with one paragraph on what the top 10 have in common. Research, not a recommendation.

top10-buy-now/admin.note: Ranks the US mega caps universe; change the universe or strategy on the leaderboard node, or set your own watchlist of up to 25 symbols.

value-bargains/admin.name: Cheap & solid bargains

nodes.label: Bargains
nodes.rule: pe_ttm < 20 and net_margin_pct >= 8 and above_sma200 and not (flags contains "shrinking_revenue")

nodes.label: Value memo
nodes.prompt: Use only figures that appear in the input data and name the date they are as of. Leaderboard scores are 0–100 percentiles within the ranked universe (value, quality, growth, momentum, timing, risk), not price targets or predictions. Keep the table at the top. For each company: the facts that make it cheap (P/E, earnings yield, margins), the assumption that must hold for the discount to close, and the value-trap risk (low growth, falling margins). Research, not a recommendation.

value-bargains/admin.note: Weekly. A low P/E alone is not a bargain: the screen also asks for margins, an intact trend and growing revenue.

garp-growth/admin.name: Growth at a reasonable price

nodes.label: Fair-priced growth
nodes.rule: revenue_growth_pct >= 10 and peg < 2 and not (flags contains "unprofitable")

nodes.label: Growth memo
nodes.prompt: Use only figures that appear in the input data and name the date they are as of. Leaderboard scores are 0–100 percentiles within the ranked universe (value, quality, growth, momentum, timing, risk), not price targets or predictions. Keep the table at the top. For each company: the growth the numbers show, what has to keep going right for the PEG to stay reasonable, and the first sign that would break the thesis. Research, not a recommendation.

garp-growth/admin.note: PEG is the trailing P/E divided by trailing EPS growth; companies with shrinking EPS have none and do not pass.

macro-regime/admin.name: Macro regime shift

nodes.label: What changed
nodes.prompt: Use only figures that appear in the input data and name the date they are as of. The input is the current macro regime (risk_on, caution or risk_off) with the signals behind it. Explain in under 150 words what changed and what such a regime has usually meant for a long-term investor: keep contributions going, check the plan, avoid reacting to one reading. Do not predict markets.

macro-regime/admin.note: Needs the FRED plugin and FRED_API_KEY. Reports when the regime changes and reminds you every two weeks while it holds.
